pages.title: Sterile Pack
pages.text: Swabs, wipes and a fresh filter, sealed and steamed in the Autoclave until not one spore in a trillion is left alive. Use it on a Biology machine to bring it back to fully sterile and clear any contamination. Made in the Autoclave.
